dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: We must've been fated to meet in such a wonderful place.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: Even though the waves that flow to the harbor every day may not come from the same sea, the two of us got to meet here. What is it if not a miracle?

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: Where are you from? Tell me about yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: I possess a wealth of knowledge and experience. Be it ice fishing in Snezhnaya, or boat rowing in Fontaine, I know it all. In fact, I know a little bit of everything.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: So, we can talk about anything you like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Learning about me would cost you a fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I understand. Everyone has their own fate, none less precious than anybody else's.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: But if you really want to put a price on it, I just might be able to afford it.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: If my background were worse, I wouldn't be able to go on the streets and meet people from all walks of life.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: Anyway, you know where to find me. If you ever need a friend, I'm right here waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: Fate shall let us cross paths again.
